tips.午: noon: a slanted tick on top; the stem starts at the upper line, nothing pokes through it
tips.牛: cow: the stem pokes up through the top line like a horn and runs past the bottom line
tips.生: life: three lines, the longest at the bottom as ground; a sprout stem pokes up through them
tips.年: year: like noon but three lines, with a short stub on the left joining the lower two

scene: At noon the sun sits flat overhead while a cow with one horn poking up grazes beside a sprout of new life rising from a long ground line, and a stepped fence marks the turn of the year.
contrast: Cow's horn pokes through · noon's stem stops flat at the roof · life grows from long ground · each year adds a notch on the left

午.feature: The stem starts at the upper line: nothing pokes above it, a flat roof with one slanted sun ray on top.
午.label: flat top
午.hook: At NOON the Goblin's laundry pole stops flat under the roof: nothing pokes up, just one hot sun ray.
午.picture: A goblin's laundry pole standing under a flat wooden roof beam, its top hidden beneath it, a single slanted sunbeam smoking on the roof.

牛.feature: The vertical stem pokes up above the top horizontal like a horn.
牛.label: horn
牛.hook: The cow's one horn rams up through the barn beam: only the COW pokes through the top.
牛.picture: A cow on an ice rink whose single huge horn has smashed up through a wooden ceiling beam, splinters flying, a figure skater gripping the horn.

生.feature: A long ground line at the very bottom, with a sprout stem rising from it.
生.label: ground
生.hook: LIFE: the Sailor's sprout bursts up out of a long strip of ground at the bottom.
生.picture: A sailor pouring seawater onto a long flat strip of bare earth from which a green sprout bursts upward, gasping.

年.feature: A short stub on the left joins the two lower lines, like a notch.
年.label: notch
年.hook: Each YEAR the Neanderthal hacks one short notch on the left side of his cow's hide.
年.picture: A friendly caveman carves one short notch on the left side of a wooden calendar post, next to a calm cow grazing; a big sun overhead.

tips.十: ten: a plain cross, one straight line each way
tips.七: seven: the crossbar tilts up and the stem bends sharply right at the bottom
tips.千: thousand: a cross with a slanted drop stroke sitting on top

scene: Ten coins rest on a plain cross-shaped signpost, seven hockey sticks curl right at the bottom, and a thousand birds perch on a cross topped by one slanted feather.
contrast: Ten is a plain cross · seven's stem curls right · thousand gets an ink drop on top

十.feature: A plain cross: two straight lines, no drop, no curl.
十.label: plain cross
十.hook: TEN diamonds: the jewel thief cuts a plain straight cross, no curls, no drips, just in and out.
十.picture: A thief in black cutting a perfectly straight plus-shaped hole in a steel vault door, ten diamonds glittering inside.

七.feature: The vertical stroke bends and curls off to the right at the bottom.
七.label: curl right
七.hook: The She-cheetah's claw swipe curls right at the bottom: SEVEN slices flicked out of Nana's pie.
七.picture: A cheetah's claw slash through a pie, the slash hooking sharply to the right at the bottom, seven slices flying, a grandma with a rolling pin.

千.feature: A slanted drop stroke sits on top of the cross.
千.label: ink drop
千.hook: Sensei flicks one slanted ink drop onto the top of the cross: it bursts into a THOUSAND specks.
千.picture: A stern teacher flicking a single big slanted ink blob onto the top of a chalk cross, which explodes into a thousand tiny specks.

tips.木: tree: one crossbar, a trunk and two branches, nothing else
tips.本: book: tree with a short bar across the base of the trunk, like a book's spine
tips.未: not yet: an extra line above the crossbar, the top one SHORTER: the tree is not yet grown
tips.末: extremity: an extra line above the crossbar, the top one LONGER: reaching to the very tip

scene: A plain tree stands beside a book wedged across its trunk's base; a not yet grown sapling has a short top branch, while an extremity tree spreads its longest branch at the very top.
contrast: Tree is bare · book gets a bar at the roots · not-yet has a short top branch · extremity a long top branch

木.feature: A bare tree: one crossbar, trunk and two roots, no extra bar anywhere.
木.label: bare tree
木.hook: The Mockingbird hides your key in a bare TREE: one branch, two roots, nothing else to grab.
木.picture: A plain tree with one crossing branch and two roots, a mockingbird perched on it holding a key in its beak.

本.feature: A short bar across the base of the trunk, low between the roots.
本.label: spine
本.hook: The goose bites a bar across the trunk's base and it splits open into a BOOK, spine at the bottom.
本.picture: A tree trunk splitting open at its base into a giant book, a short wooden bar clamped across the bottom like a spine, a goose honking.

未.feature: An extra line above the crossbar, SHORTER than the crossbar below it.
未.label: short top
未.hook: Mickey's top mark is shorter than the branch below: the tree has NOT YET grown to it.
未.picture: A cartoon mouse holding a tape measure against a tree with a short stick nailed high above its wide branch, sighing.

末.feature: An extra line above the crossbar, LONGER than the crossbar below it.
末.label: long top
末.hook: At the world's EXTREMITY the top branch stretches longest; the Matador teeters on its tip.
末.picture: A tree whose topmost branch stretches far wider than all others into a starry void, a matador balancing on its very tip.

tips.工: craft: two lines joined by a stem, short on top and long below, like an I-beam
tips.土: soil: a short line crossed by a stem that pokes up, on a long ground line
tips.王: king: three lines with the stem staying inside; nothing pokes out
tips.主: lord: a king with one drop sitting on top like a jewel

scene: A craft worker sets an I-beam on the soil where a sprout pokes up, while a king in three-tiered robes stands beside a lord whose crown bears a single jewel on top.
contrast: Craft: two bars capped, nothing pokes · soil: the stem pokes over a short bar · king: three bars · lord: a king with a jewel drop

工.feature: Only two horizontals, the stem capped by the top one: nothing pokes above (an I-beam).
工.label: I-beam
工.hook: CRAFT starts on an I-beam bench: flat plank on top, post, beam below; Coach whistles faster.
工.picture: A steel I-beam workbench seen from the side with flat top and bottom, workers hammering, a coach blowing a whistle.

土.feature: The stem pokes up above the short top line, standing on a long ground line.
土.label: poke up
土.hook: The Dog's digging stick pokes up out of the SOIL mound above the short line.
土.picture: A muddy dog beside a dirt mound with a stick poking up out of its top, a long flat bank of soil below.

王.feature: Three horizontal bars joined by a stem that stays inside; nothing on top.
王.label: three bars
王.hook: Three bars, one pole, nothing on top: the Ogre yanks the pole and crowns himself KING.
王.picture: An ogre holding a pole threaded through three horizontal stone slabs, a crown on his bare head.

主.feature: A single drop sits on top of the king.
主.label: jewel drop
主.hook: One drop of holy oil on the king's head makes him LORD; the librarian hisses 'Shhh!'
主.picture: A librarian dripping a single glowing drop of oil onto a kneeling king's head, a crowd cheering behind.

tips.人: person: the long left stroke stands, the right leans against its middle
tips.入: enter: the right stroke is the tall one; the short left stroke tucks against it
tips.八: eight: two strokes spread apart and never touch

scene: A person strides along on a long left leg, a second figure ducks to enter a tent through a tall right flap, and eight sticks lean apart on the ground without touching.
contrast: Person: the tall left leg props up the right · enter: the tall right strides in · eight: two halves never touch

人.feature: The LEFT stroke is the long one; the right one leans against its middle.
人.label: tall left
人.hook: A PERSON stands on the tall left leg; the Ninja kicks the right one leaning on it.
人.picture: A ginger cat standing upright on one long left leg, the right leg leaning against it, a ninja kicking it away.

入.feature: The RIGHT stroke is the tall one; the short left stroke tucks against it.
入.label: tall right
入.hook: To ENTER, the Newt strides in on its long right leg, the short left one tucked behind.
入.picture: A slimy newt striding into a tent flap with one long right leg, a short left leg tucked in, cold toes visible.

八.feature: The two strokes are separate and never touch: a gap at the top.
八.label: gap
八.hook: The Hatchet splits the octopus: two halves flop apart, never touching, EIGHT legs wriggle.
八.picture: An octopus cut cleanly in two halves leaning apart with a clear gap between them, a hatchet in the ground, tentacles wriggling.

tips.白: white: a box with one inner line and a single drop on top
tips.百: hundred: white tucked under a long flat line on top
tips.自: oneself: the drop sits on a TALL box with two inner lines (an eye, not a sun)

scene: A white dove with one tuft feather sits on a fence, a hundred doves crowd under a long flat roof, and a person points to oneself at a tall nose.
contrast: White: a drop on a sun · hundred: a lid on top · oneself: a drop on a tall eye

白.feature: A drop over a short box with just ONE inner line (a sun), nothing above the drop.
白.label: drop + sun
白.hook: The Hacker drips one drop of bleach on the sun: the sky goes WHITE, like his screen.
白.picture: A hacker squeezing a single drop of bleach from a bottle onto a sun, the sky turning blank white.

百.feature: A long flat line lies on top as a lid above the drop.
百.label: lid
百.hook: The Hijacker's white flag hangs under a long bar: a HUNDRED parachutes, or else!
百.picture: A white flag hanging from a long horizontal pole, a hijacker waving it, a hundred parachutes piled below.

自.feature: The drop sits on a TALL box with TWO inner lines (an eye).
自.label: two bars
自.hook: The Jeep jabs at the drop above its tall two-lidded eye: 'Me! ONESELF!'
自.picture: A jeep whose tall headlight has two lids, its antenna pointing at a drop above it, honking proudly.

tips.田: rice field: a box split by a cross; nothing sticks out
tips.由: wherefore: the stem pokes out of the top only
tips.申: speaketh: the stem pokes out of both the top and the bottom

scene: A square rice field lies flat, a wherefore sprout pokes up out of its top edge like a question, and a speaketh staff pierces straight through it top and bottom.
contrast: Rice field keeps everything inside · wherefore pokes out the top · speaketh is skewered top and bottom

田.feature: A box split by a cross; nothing sticks out anywhere.
田.label: no poke
田.hook: A RICE FIELD: four flooded squares fenced in tight, not one channel escapes.
田.picture: A square rice field seen from above split into four flooded paddies, frogs croaking, a person face-down in one.

由.feature: The stem pokes out of the TOP only.
由.label: horn
由.hook: The Unicorn's horn bursts out of the top of the field; the farmer screams 'WHEREFORE?!'
由.picture: A rice field seen from above, divided into four squares, with one green sprout pushing up out of the top edge like a little stalk.

申.feature: The stem pokes out of BOTH the top and the bottom.
申.label: skewer
申.hook: The Shinto priest skewers the box clean through, top to bottom, and SPEAKETH into it.
申.picture: A Shinto priest holding a staff skewered straight through a box from top to bottom, speaking into it like a microphone.

tips.持: hold: fingers (扌) on the left of the temple
tips.待: wait: going (彳: two slashes and a stem) on the left of the temple
tips.時: time: a sun (日) on the left of the temple
tips.特: special: a cow (牛) on the left of the temple, its bottom line slanting up
tips.等: etc.: bamboo on top, the temple sitting underneath

scene: At a Buddhist temple a monk's hand holds a bell, a pilgrim on the path is told to wait, a sundial tells the time, a special cow wears a garland, and bamboo, pine, etc. grow on the roof.
contrast: Fingers hold the temple · going makes you wait · a sun tells the time · a cow is special · bamboo on top lists etc.

持.feature: Fingers (扌: a bar, a hooked stem and a rising flick) on the left.
持.label: fingers
持.hook: Giant fingers on the left HOLD the whole temple over the moat.
持.picture: A giant hand pinching a whole temple between finger and thumb, dangling it over a castle moat, monks screaming.

待.feature: Going (彳: two slashes over a stem) on the left.
待.label: going
待.hook: Two quick steps on the left and you stop to WAIT; the Tiger leans closer.
待.picture: Two footprints leading up stone steps to a temple gate, a person waiting while a tiger leans in licking its lips.

時.feature: A small sun (日) on the left.
時.label: sun
時.hook: The Jeep drags the sun round the temple: the sundial spins and TIME races.
時.picture: A jeep dragging a small sun on a chain around a temple, a sundial spinning wildly.

特.feature: A cow (牛) on the left, its bottom line slanting up.
特.label: cow
特.hook: A garlanded cow on the left is the SPECIAL guest; the host shoves a mic in its face.
特.picture: A cow in flower garlands at a temple gate, a talk-show host thrusting a microphone at it.

等.feature: Bamboo (two little ⺮ sprouts) on top, the temple beneath.
等.label: bamboo
等.hook: Under a bamboo roof the Toad croaks his list: candles, bells, ETC.
等.picture: A toad under a canopy of bamboo leaves above a temple, reading an endless scroll.

tips.休: rest: person + a plain tree, no bar on the trunk
tips.体: body: person + book, a short bar across the base of the trunk

scene: A hiker leans against a plain tree to rest, while a second person stretches their body against a tree that has a book jammed across its trunk.
contrast: Rest leans on a bare tree · body wears a book with a bar at the base

休.feature: A plain tree on the right: no bar on the trunk.
休.label: no bar
休.hook: A person leans on a bare tree to REST; the Cucumber slices itself onto their eyes.
休.picture: A person slumped against a plain tree trunk with cucumber slices on their eyes, the tree snoring.

体.feature: A short bar across the base of the trunk (本, book).
体.label: bar
体.hook: A thick book strapped low across the BODY: the Tiger's claws shred paper, not skin.
体.picture: A man wearing a thick book as armor strapped low on his body, a tiger's claws stuck in the pages.

tips.天: heavens: two lines; the body hangs from the lower one, nothing pokes above the top line
tips.夫: husband: the head pokes up through the top line like a hairpin
tips.失: lose: husband plus a slanted stroke at top left, as if something slips off

scene: Under the open heavens a husband with a hairpin poking up through his hat stands on a hill, as a gust tilts a second hat off his head and he loses it.
contrast: Heavens: head stays under the ceiling · husband's head pokes through · lose: a slash slips off the top left

天.feature: The head stays under the top line: nothing pokes above the ceiling.
天.label: ceiling
天.hook: The dog bonks its head on the ceiling bar of the HEAVENS and falls back: nothing gets through.
天.picture: A St. Bernard dog flying upward and bonking its head flat against a ceiling of sky, brandy barrel sloshing.

夫.feature: The head (the long stroke) pokes up through the top line like a hairpin.
夫.label: hairpin
夫.hook: Otto the HUSBAND's head pokes up through the top bar like a hairpin.
夫.picture: A giant groom whose head sticks up through a horizontal beam like a hairpin, a fool juggling rings.

失.feature: An extra slanted stroke at the top left.
失.label: slip
失.hook: A slash at the top left knocks the pin askew: the husband LOSES his ring.
失.picture: A sword slash knocking a hairpin crooked at the top left, a wedding ring falling into a drain, a sheet ghost giggling.

tips.支: branch: ten (十) on top of the crotch (又)
tips.友: friend: a crossed hand (ナ) over the crotch; the slash pokes above the line
tips.反: anti-: a cliff (厂) roof over the crotch; nothing pokes above

scene: A cross-shaped branch leans on a tree, two friends cross arms above their heads, and an anti- protester crouches under a cliff overhang.
contrast: Branch: a ten on top · friend: the slash pokes above · anti-: a flat cliff roof

支.feature: A ten (十: a cross) sits on top of the crotch.
支.label: ten
支.hook: A ten-pronged cross sprouts from the crotch: a BRANCH the Sheep leans on.
支.picture: A twig shaped like a plus sign sprouting from a tree's fork, an exhausted sheep leaning on it.

友.feature: The slash pokes up above the top line.
友.label: poke
友.hook: The Unicorn's horn pokes above the line, it kicks you, but stays your FRIEND.
友.picture: A unicorn with its horn poking up through a horizontal bar, offering a ride to a doubled-over person.

反.feature: A flat cliff roof (厂): the slash starts at the line, nothing pokes above.
反.label: cliff
反.hook: Han Solo hangs under a flat cliff roof yelling ANTI-everything.
反.picture: A space smuggler dangling by his trousers under a flat cliff overhang, waving a protest banner.

tips.力: power: a hook bending down-left, crossed by a slash that pokes above it
tips.九: nine: the second stroke ends in a hook curling RIGHT along the bottom
tips.万: ten thousand: power with a flat line laid on top
tips.方: direction: ten thousand with a dot on top

scene: A strongman flexes his power beside a cat with nine lives curling its tail to the right, while ten thousand soldiers march under a flat banner and a signpost topped with one dot points the direction.
contrast: Power's slash pokes above · nine's hook curls right · ten thousand gets a flat lid · direction a dot on top

力.feature: No lid: the slash pokes up above the hooked arm.
力.label: pokes up
力.hook: POWER: the innkeeper's arm hooks down and his fist punches up through the top.
力.picture: A bulging arm bent into a hook with a fist punching up above it, suitcases stacked on it.

九.feature: The second stroke ends in a hook curling RIGHT along the bottom.
九.label: right curl
九.hook: The cat leaps, tail curling right along the floor: NINE lives, minus one.
九.picture: A frightened cat in mid-leap with its tail curling far out to the right along the ground, a cucumber behind it.

万.feature: A long flat line laid on top as a lid.
万.label: lid
万.hook: The Mantis hangs from one flat ceiling bar over TEN THOUSAND ants.
万.picture: A mantis wrapped in silk hanging from a long flat ceiling beam, an endless crowd of ants below.

方.feature: A dot on top of the line.
方.label: dot
方.hook: The Hobo spins the signpost by its top dot until it picks a DIRECTION.
方.picture: A signpost with a round knob on top spinning, a hobo with a bindle walking the way it points.

tips.馬: horse: starts with a stem and three crossbars like a mane; no drop on top
tips.魚: fish: a slanted cap (⺈) on top and a rice field (田) body
tips.鳥: bird: one slash drop on top of a box with a line inside, the bird's eye

scene: A horse with a combed mane, a fish with a checkered rice-field belly and a bird with a single tuft on its head stand in a row above four glowing campfire dots.
contrast: Horse: a flat mane, no drop · fish: a slanted cap over a rice field · bird: a drop on its eye

馬.feature: No drop on top: it starts with a stem and three crossbars like a mane.
馬.label: mane
馬.hook: The HORSE's three-bar mane streams flat on top; the Baboon clings on.
馬.picture: A horse with three stiff horizontal mane bars, a baboon jockey whipping it, four hooves thundering.

魚.feature: A slanted cap (⺈) on top, over a rice-field (田) body.
魚.label: cap
魚.hook: The FISH wears a slanted cap over its grid-scored body; Gyoro bulges in horror.
魚.picture: A fish with a slanted pointed cap on its head and a grid on its body, roasting over flames, a goggle-eyed goldfish watching.

鳥.feature: A single slash drop on top, over a box with a line inside (the eye).
鳥.label: head tuft
鳥.hook: The BIRD's head tuft flicks over its boxy eye; the Chow Chow snaps at it.
鳥.picture: A bird with a single feather tuft on its boxy head and flame-like tail feathers, a chow chow dog leaping.

tips.情: feelings: a heart (忄: a stem with two dots) at the left of blue
tips.晴: clear up: a sun (日) at the left of blue
tips.精: refined: rice (米) at the left of blue
tips.静: quiet: blue on the LEFT, contend (争) on the right

scene: Under a blue sky, a girl full of feelings watches the sun clear up the clouds, a cook sifts refined rice, and a monk sits quiet beside two sleeping wrestlers.
contrast: Feelings: a heart on the left · clear up: a sun · refined: rice · quiet: blue moves left, contend on the right

情.feature: A heart (忄: a stem with two dots) on the left.
情.label: heart
情.hook: Your heart on the left turns blue: FEELINGS leak as blue tears.
情.picture: A heart on a stem shedding blue tears, a joker licking them up.

晴.label: sun
晴.hook: The Sailor's foghorn blows the clouds off the sun: it CLEARS UP.
晴.picture: A sailor blowing a foghorn, storm clouds parting to reveal a sun beside a blue sky.

精.feature: Rice (米: a cross with four spray strokes) on the left.
精.label: rice
精.hook: The Sailor polishes rice grains until they glow: REFINED.
精.picture: A sailor polishing glowing rice grains in a bowl, his spirit floating out.

静.feature: Contend (争) on the RIGHT; blue moves over to the left.
静.label: contend
静.hook: Two pirates contend on the right until the Sailor chokes them QUIET.
静.picture: Two pirates sword-fighting in a library, a sailor wrapping an anchor chain around them, all silent.

tips.険: precipitous: a pinnacle (阝) on the left of the pointed awl roof
tips.験: verification: a horse (馬) on the left of the pointed awl roof

scene: A climber clings to a precipitous cliff beside a pointed tent, while at the next pointed tent a horse waits for verification at a checkpoint.
contrast: Precipitous: a narrow pinnacle on the left · verification: a whole horse on the left

険.feature: A pinnacle (阝: a small ear-shaped hook on a long stem) on the left.
険.label: pinnacle
険.hook: Ken doll clings to a skinny hooked pinnacle on the left: one slip on this PRECIPITOUS cliff.
険.picture: A thin hooked rock spire on a sheer cliff, an awl jammed in it, a plastic doll dangling with a cracked smile.

験.feature: A horse (馬: mane of bars and four hoof dots) on the left.
験.label: horse
験.hook: A whole horse stands on the left for drug VERIFICATION; the awl pops Ken doll's butt.
験.picture: A racehorse at a starting gate being jabbed with a giant awl by a judge, a plastic doll jockey bouncing off.

tips.安: relax: a woman (女) under the roof
tips.字: character: a child (子) under the roof
tips.守: guard: glue (寸: a hooked stem with a dot) under the roof
tips.宅: home: a rooftop tail (乇) curling right under the roof

scene: Under four little roofs: a woman lies back to relax, a child dresses as a storybook character, a guard stands with a hooked staff, and a home has a cat's tail curling out the door.
contrast: Relax: a woman under the roof · character: a child · guard: a glued hook with a dot · home: a tail curling right

安.feature: A woman (女: crossed legs and a long arm line) under the roof.
安.label: woman
安.hook: The Antelope curls in the woman's lap under the roof: at last they both RELAX.
安.picture: An antelope curled asleep in a woman's lap inside a cozy house, both snoring, lions sulking outside the window.

字.feature: A child (子: a hooked body with arms out) under the roof.
字.label: child
字.hook: A child under the roof scratches glowing CHARACTERs on every wall; the Jeep crashes in to read.
字.picture: A small child with arms outstretched scratching glowing symbols onto the walls of a tiny house, jeep headlights bursting through the door.

守.feature: Glue (寸: a bar, a hooked stem and a dot) under the roof.
守.label: glue
守.hook: The Sumo wrestler, glued to the floor by one dot, is the ultimate GUARD; burglars bounce off.
守.picture: A sumo wrestler sitting under a roof, stuck to the floor by a gooey glue blob, burglars bouncing off his belly.

宅.feature: A rooftop tail (乇) whose long stroke curls out right at the bottom.
宅.label: tail
宅.hook: A hairy tail curls right under your roof; the Taxi driver hooks it and tows your HOME.
宅.picture: A long hairy tail curling out from under a house roof, hooked to a taxi's bumper, the house dragged down the street.

tips.今: now: under the umbrella only a short line and a hooked stroke, no box
tips.会: meeting: under the umbrella two lines and an elbow (ム) like a cloud
tips.合: fit: under the umbrella one line and a mouth (口) box

scene: Under one umbrella a man checks his watch for now, under a second a meeting gathers beneath a rising cloud, and under a third a lid fits snugly on a square box.
contrast: Now: just a fishhook under the umbrella · meeting: a rising cloud · fit: a mouth box

今.feature: Under the umbrella only a short line and a hook: no box, no cloud.
今.label: hook
今.hook: Just a bare fishhook under the Conductor's umbrella snags you: play NOW!
今.picture: A conductor's umbrella with a single fishhook dangling below, snagging a dozing violinist by the collar.

会.feature: A line over an elbow with a dot (ム), a rising cloud, under the umbrella.
会.label: cloud
会.hook: Under one umbrella the Kite flyer puffs a rising cloud: MEETING, nobody leaves!
会.picture: People crowded under one huge umbrella in a rising puff of smoke, all tied together with a kite string.

合.feature: One line over a closed mouth (口) box under the umbrella.
合.label: mouth
合.hook: The pointed roof slams onto the mouth box like a lid that FITS; the Goalie yelps 'Ow!'
合.picture: A pointed lid slamming perfectly onto a square box, a goalie's gloved fingers pinched in the seam.

tips.全: whole: umbrella over a king (王), nothing else
tips.余: too much: umbrella over a line and a hooked stem with two little feet, no king
tips.金: gold: umbrella over a king with two small dots beside the stem

scene: A whole king sits under an umbrella, a second umbrella shelters a little tree weighed down with too much fruit, and a third shelters a king with two gold nuggets at his feet.
contrast: Whole: a bare king under the umbrella · too much: a hooked stem with two feet · gold: a king with two drops

全.feature: A plain king (王: three bars and a stem) under the umbrella, no dots.
全.label: king
全.hook: A bare king under a colossal umbrella shelters the WHOLE kingdom; the Zen monk trembles.
全.picture: A king standing under a colossal umbrella with an entire kingdom crowded beneath, a zen monk holding the pole, arms shaking.

余.feature: A hooked stem with two little feet splaying out below.
余.label: feet
余.hook: Yogurt pours TOO MUCH and the little tree's two feet splay out, drowning in gloop.
余.picture: A tiny tree with two splayed little feet standing in a flood of yogurt overflowing a small umbrella.

金.feature: Two small drops beside the king's stem.
金.label: two drops
金.hook: Two drops of molten GOLD leak through and sizzle on each side of the king's stem.
金.picture: A cowering king under an umbrella as two glowing drops of molten gold sizzle on the floor either side of his feet.

tips.冷: cool: ice (two dots) on the left of orders (令)
tips.命: fate: a mouth (口) tucked in at lower left under the umbrella

scene: An ice cube on the left cools an officer reading orders, while under a tent a fortune teller with an open mouth announces someone's fate.
contrast: Cool: two ice chips on the left · fate: a mouth tucked under the umbrella

冷.feature: Ice (冫: two dots) on the left.
冷.label: ice
冷.hook: The Raven pecks two ice chips off the left: COOL it down! His feathers frost stiff.
冷.picture: A raven pecking two chips off a block of ice beside a pile of drinks, its feathers frosted white.

命.feature: A mouth (口) tucked in at the lower left under the umbrella.
命.label: mouth
命.hook: The Mayor's small mouth, tucked under his orders, barks one word: your FATE.
命.picture: A mayor with a tiny mouth tucked under a pointed umbrella barking a single word, a kneeling person trembling.

tips.妹: younger sister: woman + not yet (未): a tree with a short extra top line
tips.姉: elder sister: woman + market (市): a top hat over a hanging towel

scene: A younger sister plants a sapling that is not yet grown, while her elder sister in a top hat carries a towel home from the market.
contrast: Younger sister is a tree with a short top line · elder sister wears a dot-topped hat over a towel

妹.feature: Not yet (未): a tree with a short extra top line, no dot on top.
妹.label: short top
妹.hook: Your YOUNGER SISTER is a tree not yet grown: a short top branch; the Mime copies her pout.
妹.picture: A small girl perched on a young tree whose top branch is stubby and short, a mime copying her pouty face.

姉.feature: Market (市): a dot on top over a hanging towel (巾).
姉.label: hat dot
姉.hook: Your bossy ELDER SISTER wears a dot-topped hat as she storms the market; the Sheep buckles.
姉.picture: A bossy woman in a hat with a round knob on top storming through a market, piling bags onto a sheep.

tips.束: bundle: a crossbar, then a plain mouth box pierced by the trunk, legs slanting out
tips.車: car: no slanting legs; a crossed box between a top line and a long bottom axle
tips.東: east: like bundle but the box has a line inside (a sun), legs slanting out
tips.果: fruit: a rice-field box sits on top of the tree; no line or stem above it

scene: A bundle of sticks tied with a ring lies beside a car with flat bumpers, while the sun rises in the east tangled in a tree and another tree is crowned with a big square fruit.
contrast: Bundle squeezes an empty mouth · car skewers a crossed box on a long axle · east has a sun bar inside · fruit wears its field on top

束.feature: the box is an empty mouth (no line inside), with legs slanting out below
束.label: empty mouth
束.hook: Sock puppet's mouth is EMPTY: it just clamps the trunk shut into a tight BUNDLE — nothing inside but wood.
束.picture: A sock puppet with a huge gaping empty mouth clamped around the middle of a thin tree trunk, squeezing the branches into a tight bundle tied with rope.

車.feature: a long bottom axle line and no slanting legs
車.label: axle
車.hook: A CAR rolls on a long axle, not legs — Shark grips the wide bottom bar like a steering wheel.
車.picture: A cartoon car seen from above with an absurdly long glowing axle sticking out past both sides, a shark fin poking out of its sunroof.

東.feature: a sun bar inside the box (two inner lines), with legs slanting out
東.label: sun bar
東.hook: In the EAST the sun sits INSIDE the tree's box; Toad's tongue licks the hot middle bar and sizzles.
東.picture: A bright rising sun trapped inside a square wooden crate halfway up a tree, a toad stretching its long tongue onto the glowing sun, steam puffing.

果.feature: the rice-field box sits at the very top, with no line above it
果.label: field on top
果.hook: FRUIT tree with a whole muddy field balanced on its crown — nothing above the box but sky.
果.picture: A tree whose top is a square muddy rice paddy instead of leaves, square brown apples rolling off, a small car bumping the trunk.

tips.連: take along: a car (車) riding on the road
tips.速: quick: a bundle (束) on the road, its box on slanting legs
tips.運: carry: a car under a crown (冖) on the road

scene: On a road a car tows a trailer to take along friends, a quick runner dashes past with a bundle, and a truck under a canvas cover rolls by to carry crates.
contrast: Take along drags a bare car on a flat axle · quick straps on a bundle with kicking legs · carry puts a coffin lid on top

連.feature: a bare car on the road: flat bottom axle, no lid on top and no legs
連.label: bare car
連.hook: TAKE ALONG: a bare little car trails its flat axle like a tow bar, the Wren swinging from the chain.
連.picture: A plain open-top car on a road with a long flat tow bar dragging a rattling chain of family trailers, a small wren tangled in the chain.

速.feature: slanting legs kick out under the box (a bundle, not a car)
速.label: rocket legs
速.hook: QUICK! Two legs splay out under Sock puppet's bundle like rocket exhausts, burning skid marks.
速.picture: A sock puppet with a bundle of rockets on its back, two flame jets splaying diagonally downward like legs as it blasts down a road.

運.feature: a crown-like lid (army helmet) over the car
運.label: lid
運.hook: To CARRY the coffin, the army slams a big lid over the car — the cobra hisses under it.
運.picture: Soldiers marching down a road carrying a car-shaped coffin with a heavy curved lid on top, a cobra peeking out from under the lid.

tips.頂: place on the head: a simple street hook (丁) on the left of head
tips.頭: head: beans (豆) on the left of head
tips.題: topic: just so (是) on the left, its long sweep running under head

scene: A porter learns to place on the head a T-shaped tray, a cook balances a bowl of beans on his head, and a speaker sweeps his arm low to introduce the topic.
contrast: Place on the head wears a T-shaped nail · head bonks a bean bowl · topic sweeps a long tail under the head

頂.feature: a simple T-shaped nail (two strokes) on the left
頂.label: T-nail
頂.hook: PLACE ON THE HEAD: a lone T-shaped nail is the Chow Chow's crown — just a bar and a hook.
頂.picture: A fluffy chow chow dog on a mountain summit wearing a giant T-shaped iron nail balanced on its head like a crown.

頭.feature: a bean bowl on a stand on the left (box, two dots, base line)
頭.label: bean bowl
頭.hook: HEAD smashed into a bean bowl on a stand: two beans fly up as the giraffe's skull lands.
頭.picture: A giraffe slamming its huge head into a footed bowl of beans held by a zookeeper, two beans flying up in the air.

題.feature: a long sweeping tail that runs underneath the head
題.label: tail
題.hook: TOPIC: the Dinosaur's tail sweeps right under its own roaring head — the one that underlines it.
題.picture: A muddy dinosaur whose enormous tail curls along the ground beneath its giant roaring head, like an underline.

tips.顔: face: lad (彦: vase, cliff and three hairs) on the left of head
tips.願: petition: meadow (原: cliff over white and little) on the left of head

scene: A smiling face with three wisps of hair peeks over a cliff, while below on a meadow a person kneels to petition.
contrast: Face streams three hair strands · petition kneels by a little waterfall in the meadow

顔.feature: three slanting hair strokes inside the cliff on the left
顔.label: hair
顔.hook: FACE pressed to the glass: three strands of the lad's hair smear down the window — 'Car, oh!'
顔.picture: A boy's face squashed flat against a car window, three long slanted streaks of hair plastered across the glass.

願.feature: a little spring/waterfall (small 小 shape) below the white box on the left
願.label: spring
願.hook: PETITION: you bow so hard a tiny spring bursts from the meadow, splashing three ways.
願.picture: A person kneeling and bowing in a grassy meadow, a small three-pronged spring of water bursting up from the ground in front of their forehead.

tips.産: products: vase on a cliff over life (生); no head on the right
tips.顔: face: vase on a cliff with three hair strokes, and head (頁) on the right

scene: Farm products pile up under a cliff top, and next to them a face with three hair strokes peeks around the pile.
contrast: Products grow life under the cliff with no head · face puts a head on the right

産.feature: life (a sprout on ground lines) under the cliff, and no head on the right
産.label: life
産.hook: PRODUCTS: under the cliff a sprout of life pops out of stacked ground — Santa bags it, no head anywhere.
産.picture: Santa scooping a sprouting plant and farm produce from layered soil beneath a cliff edge, a tipped vase above.

顔.feature: a head (box with legs) on the right
顔.label: head
顔.hook: FACE needs a head: the big boxy head on the right is what's squashed on the glass.
顔.picture: A big boxy cartoon head pressed flat against a car window, its cheeks spreading over the glass.

tips.売: sell: soldier over crown over human legs, standing alone
tips.続: continue: sell with thread (糸) on the left
tips.読: read: sell with say (言) on the left

scene: A merchant sells goods from a stall, a customer reads aloud from a blank scroll, and a ball of thread continues unrolling down the street.
contrast: Sell stands alone · continue spins thread on the left · read says words on the left

売.feature: nothing on the left: the crown-soldier-legs stack stands alone
売.label: alone
売.hook: SELL stands alone: the Biker sprints off solo with the crown, no helper beside him.
売.picture: A muddy biker sprinting alone down an empty street clutching a stolen golden crown toward a pawnshop.

続.feature: a twisted thread on the left
続.label: thread
続.hook: CONTINUE: a twisted thread on the left never ends — the Zombie keeps slurping it like spaghetti.
続.picture: A zombie endlessly slurping a twisted thread unspooling from a giant spool, the thread stretching to the horizon.

読.feature: the 'say' radical (dot, three lines, little mouth) on the left
読.label: say
読.hook: READ: a talking mouth with stacked lines on the left — the Doctor says every word aloud.
読.picture: A doctor squinting at a tiny pill label, a huge open mouth beside him with speech lines stacked above it.

tips.主: lord: a drop over a king, standing alone
tips.住: dwell: lord with a person (亻) on the left
tips.注: pour: lord with water (氵) on the left

scene: A lord wears a crown with one jewel, a person dwells in a hut beside him, and a servant pours water from a jug.
contrast: Lord stands alone · dwell puts a person beside him · pour splashes water from the left

主.feature: nothing on the left: just the drop on the king
主.label: alone
主.hook: LORD stands alone: one drop of oil on the king and no one else beside him.
主.picture: A single king standing alone on a stage as one glowing drop of oil falls onto his crown.

住.feature: a person radical (slant + stem) on the left
住.label: person
住.hook: DWELL: a sneaky person leans against the lord's left side — Jewel thief moved in.
住.picture: A sneaky thief leaning against a sleeping king's bedside, eyeing the crown jewels in a castle bedroom.

注.feature: three water drops on the left
注.label: water
注.hook: POUR: three splashes of icy water fly from the left onto the lord — Chewbacca roars.
注.picture: A gardener pours water from a watering can onto a single golden crown resting on a stand, splashing droplets on the left side.

tips.仕: attend: person + soldier (士), no slash on top
tips.任: responsibility: person + porter (壬), a slanted stroke on top of the cross

scene: A soldier stands to attend a person, while a porter with a slanted pack on top shoulders the responsibility of a heavy pole.
contrast: Attend serves a bare soldier · responsibility puts a slanted load on the porter's head

仕.feature: no slanted stroke on top: a bare soldier cross
仕.label: no hat
仕.hook: ATTEND: the soldier stands bare-headed, nothing on top — Sheep licks his boots.
仕.picture: A sheep licking the boots of a bare-headed soldier until they shine.

任.feature: a slanted stroke on top of the right side, like a load on the porter's head
任.label: load
任.hook: RESPONSIBILITY: a slanted load sits on the porter's head — the Ninja catches it.
任.picture: A ninja porter balancing a tilted stack of suitcases on top of his head.

tips.小: little: a hooked stem with two dots, nothing else
tips.少: few: little plus a long slash sweeping down left at the bottom

scene: A little bird sits on a stick with two seeds, and beside it a few seeds slide away down a long slanting chute.
contrast: Little is a cane and two fleas · few gets a slash across the bottom

小.feature: no slash: just the cane and two fleas
小.label: no slash
小.hook: LITTLE: just a cane and two fleas — nothing cuts through the Showman's act.
小.picture: A showman with a cane planted in the middle of a stage, two tiny fleas hopping on either side.

少.feature: a long slash sweeping across the bottom
少.label: slash
少.hook: FEW: a long slash knifes across the bottom, sweeping almost everything away.
少.picture: A giant knife slashing diagonally across a tiny stage, leaving a few crumbs under a spotlight.

tips.水: water: a hooked stem with strokes flowing out left and right
tips.求: request: water with a flat line on top and a dot at the upper right

scene: Water splashes from a garden fountain, and beside it a smiling person holds out a flat tray with one drop on its corner, asking for more.
contrast: Water splashes bare · request hangs a pipe on top with a drip

水.feature: no line on top: just splashes off a central stem
水.label: no lid
水.hook: WATER sprays freely — nothing on top, just the Swimmer sliding down the middle.
水.picture: A swimmer belly-flopping down a rock with water spraying in arcs left and right under an open sky.

求.feature: a line on top with a little drop at its right end
求.label: pipe + drip
求.hook: REQUEST: a rusty pipe across the top with a drip on its tip — Cucumber squeezes it out.
求.picture: A thirsty man under a horizontal rusty pipe, a cucumber perched on its end squeezing out one drop.

tips.上: above: a stem with one short tick to the right, on a long base line
tips.止: stop: above plus a short extra post on the left
tips.正: correct: stop with a lid line across the top

scene: A flag points above a long base line, a barrier with an extra short post makes the traffic stop, and a lid placed on top marks the job correct.
contrast: Above is one pole on the floor · stop adds a left post · correct puts a lid on top

上.feature: a single pole with a flag to the right: no left post, no top line
上.label: one pole
上.hook: ABOVE: one lone pole with a little flag — the Joker climbs it and dangles over you.
上.picture: A muddy joker clinging to the top of a single tall pole with a tiny side flag, dripping mud below.

止.feature: a short extra post on the left
止.label: left post
止.hook: STOP: a second short post blocks the left — the Sheep slam into it.
止.picture: A flock of sheep piled up against a short wooden barrier post on a road.

正.label: top line
正.hook: CORRECT: a painted line on top marks the exact spot — the Sailor parks right under it.
正.picture: A sailor parking a ship precisely under a bright painted line hanging overhead.

tips.下: below: a top line with a stem hanging down and a dot at its right
tips.不: negative: below plus a slash sweeping down left from the line

scene: A plumb line hangs below a ceiling beam with one drop beside it, and on the next beam a broken branch slants off to the left as a man shakes his head in a negative way.
contrast: Below just hangs a wand with a dot · negative throws a flailing arm to the left

下.feature: no left arm: only the wand and a dot on the right
下.label: no arm
下.hook: BELOW: the wand hangs straight down, only a dot on its right — the Car drills under it.
下.picture: A magic wand hanging from a ceiling pointing downward, a car drilling through the floor beneath it.

不.feature: a long slanting arm sweeping down to the left
不.label: arm
不.hook: NEGATIVE: the fan's arm flails out to the left under the crossbar — 'NO!'
不.picture: A stick-figure fan under a fallen goal crossbar, one arm flung wildly to the side, a referee holding a red card.

tips.足: leg: a mouth (口) on top of the foot
tips.走: run: soil (土) on top of the foot, a cross poking up

scene: A leg in a boot with a wide open mouth-shaped kneecap stands still, while a runner kicks up soil as he starts to run.
contrast: Leg has a mouth on top · run has soil on top

足.label: mouth
足.hook: LEG with a mouth on top — the Sock puppet bites the kicking foot.
足.picture: A kicking leg topped by a wide open mouth instead of a knee, a sock puppet biting its toes.

走.label: soil
走.hook: RUN: the Soldier bursts out of a mound of soil on top and sprints off.
走.picture: A soldier bursting up out of a dirt mound and sprinting away, clumps of soil flying.

tips.同: same: a flat line inside the hood above the mouth; nothing on top
tips.向: yonder: a small drop pokes out on top of the hood; no inner line

scene: Two identical same mailboxes stand side by side, and a third with a little chimney on top faces off yonder.
contrast: Same puts a bar over the mouth under a flat hood · yonder fires a drop off the top of the hood

同.feature: a bar inside the hood above the mouth, and nothing sticking up on top
同.label: bar
同.hook: SAME: every monk has the same bar over his mouth — the Dodo hides behind his until it squawks.
同.picture: A row of identical hooded monks each with a wooden bar across their mouth, one is secretly a muddy dodo.

向.feature: a drop perched on top of the hood
向.label: drop
向.hook: YONDER: a drop flies off the top of the hood toward a faraway cow — Coach whistles.
向.picture: A droplet launching from the peak of a hood and arcing far into the distance toward a cow in a field.

tips.円: circle: inside the hood a short stem drops onto a flat line
tips.内: inside: one person (人) poking up through the top of the hood
tips.肉: meat: two persons stacked inside the hood, the top one poking out

scene: A coin circle rolls past a doorway where one person peeks out from inside, and in the next doorway two people stack up to share a plate of meat.
contrast: Circle cranks a T-bar inside · inside traps one person poking through the roof · meat squeezes in two people

円.feature: a T-shaped bar inside the hood (stem and crossbar)
円.label: T-bar
円.hook: CIRCLE: the Engineer cranks a T-bar inside the frame until it bends into a round yen coin.
円.picture: An engineer turning a big T-shaped crank inside a metal arch, a shiny round coin popping out.

内.feature: one person inside whose head pokes through the roof
内.label: one person
内.hook: INSIDE: one person trapped, head poking out the roof — the Knight gets stuck too.
内.picture: A narrow box with a single person squashed inside, his head bursting through the roof, a knight in armor stuck in the doorway.

肉.feature: a second person stacked under the first inside
肉.label: second person
肉.hook: MEAT: a second person crammed under the first in the locker — Knickers wrap them like butcher's paper.
肉.picture: Two people stacked inside a narrow butcher's locker among slabs of meat, flying underpants wrapping them like paper.

tips.四: four: a closed box with two legs curling inside it
tips.西: west: a flat line on top, and the two legs drop from it into the box

scene: Four kittens curl up inside a closed box, while a second box with a lid bar on top has two posts poking through toward the setting sun in the west.
contrast: Four kicks inside a lidless box · west's saloon has a lid on top

四.feature: no lid: the legs are trapped inside a plain box
四.label: no lid
四.hook: FOUR walls and no lid line on top — the Sheep's legs kick around inside the box.
四.picture: A sheep inside a small open-topped box, its legs kicking against all four walls.

西.feature: a lid line across the top, with the doors poking up to it
西.label: lid
西.hook: WEST: the saloon wears a flat roof on top — the Sailor kicks the doors up into it.
西.picture: A sailor kicking open swinging doors of a Wild West saloon with a long flat roof beam over it.

tips.若: young: flowers over right (右): the slash pokes above the crossbar
tips.苦: suffering: flowers over old (古): a ten cross over the mouth

scene: A young sprout with flowers pokes up beside an old man under a flower pot, wincing with suffering from a bitter cross-shaped root.
contrast: Young waves a slanted right arm · suffering hangs a cross on the old grave

若.feature: a long slanted stroke sweeping down-left (the waving arm of right)
若.label: arm
若.hook: YOUNG dancers fling one arm out in a wacky diagonal under their flower crowns.
若.picture: Young festival dancers with flower crowns flinging one arm out diagonally, a grandparent's dentures flying out.

苦.feature: a vertical stem crossing the middle line (the old gravestone's cross)
苦.label: grave cross
苦.hook: SUFFERING: a cross stands upright over the old grave — Cook brews its flowers into bitter tea.
苦.picture: A cook picking flowers from an old grave marked by an upright cross, brewing them in a steaming bitter teapot.

tips.職: post: ear (耳) on the left of the sound fiesta
tips.識: discriminating: say (言) on the left of the sound fiesta

scene: At a noisy fiesta a discriminating critic speaks his verdict, while a guard at his post cups a huge ear to listen.
contrast: Post presses an ear on the left · discriminating says words on the left

職.feature: an ear (ladder frame) on the left
職.label: ear
職.hook: POST: the guard's ear on the left is pressed to the wall — the bass zaps him.
職.picture: A night guard with a giant ear pressed to a throbbing wall, his hair frizzled by the bass.

識.feature: the 'say' radical (dot, lines, little mouth) on the left
識.label: say
識.hook: DISCRIMINATING: a talking mouth on the left — the Sheikh says which drum is fake.
識.picture: A sheikh on horseback pointing at one drum in a loud festival, a big talking mouth beside him.

tips.老: old man: a spoon (匕) under the roof, curling right
tips.考: consider: a fishhook (丂: a line and a zigzag hook) under the roof
tips.者: someone: a sun (日) under the roof

scene: An old man stirs with a spoon, another man holding a zigzag fishhook pauses to consider, and someone sits beneath the sun on the same slanted roof.
contrast: Old man digs with a spoon · consider dangles a fishhook · someone fries on a sun

老.feature: a spoon below the slash whose tail curls up to the right
老.label: spoon
老.hook: OLD MAN: the Robot digs with a spoon whose tail curls up — too frail for a shovel.
老.picture: A rusty hunched robot scraping soil with a tiny spoon, its handle curling upward.

考.feature: a zigzag fishhook hanging down below the slash
考.label: fishhook
考.hook: CONSIDER: a zigzag fishhook dangles below the old man — Coach yanks it.
考.picture: An old man sitting still with a zigzag fishhook dangling below him, a coach yanking the line with his whistle.

者.feature: a sun (box with a bar) below the slash
者.label: sun
者.hook: SOMEONE help! The old man fries on a sun below him — Shark sniffs the barbecue.
者.picture: An old man sprawled on top of a blazing sun like a grill, a shark sliding up a beach sniffing.

tips.米: rice: two dots over a cross with two legs, no top line
tips.来: come: rice with a flat line on top

scene: Rice grains scatter on a straw mat, and under a flat roof beam guests come to eat.
contrast: Rice bursts with nothing on top · come lays a beam over the rice

米.feature: no top line: the two dots splay out at the very top
米.label: no beam
米.hook: RICE bursts freely, nothing on top — the comet of grains lands on Baby.
米.picture: A starburst of rice grains exploding upward into open sky, a giggling baby with rice in her hair.

来.feature: a beam line across the top
来.label: beam
来.hook: COME: rice under a beam — the Rhino charges under it with a Cool dude surfing on top.
来.picture: A rhino charging beneath a wooden beam over scattered rice, a dude in sunglasses surfing on its back.

tips.楽: music: white over ice and tree, nothing on top
tips.薬: medicine: music with flowers (艹) on top

scene: A drum on a tree plays music, and beside it a flower-topped drum holds bottles of herbal medicine.
contrast: Music plays bare in the tree · medicine grows flowers on top

楽.feature: no grass on top: the white drum starts at the top
楽.label: no flowers
楽.hook: MUSIC: the drum sits right at the top of the tree — Raccoon lounges, relaxed.
楽.picture: A white drum hanging at the top of a tree with ice chips rattling, a raccoon lounging in the branches.

薬.label: flowers
薬.hook: MEDICINE: flowers sprout on top of the music — Yak grinds them into fizzing powder.
薬.picture: A yak pharmacist grinding flowers growing on top of a drum, glowing fizzing powder in a spoon.

tips.度: degrees: cave over twenty (廿) and a crotch (又)
tips.席: seat: cave over twenty and a hanging towel (巾)
tips.渡: transit: degrees with water (氵) on the left

scene: In a cave a thermometer shows degrees, outside a ferry makes the transit across water, and inside a towel hangs over a carved seat.
contrast: Degrees ends in a crotch · seat spreads a towel · transit wades water on the left

度.feature: a crotch (crossed legs) at the bottom
度.label: crotch
度.hook: DEGREES: crossed legs at the bottom — the Dog pokes icicles there to check the temperature.
度.picture: A dog holding an icicle thermometer to a shivering hiker's crossed legs in an icy cave.

席.feature: a towel (hanging cloth on a rod) at the bottom
席.label: towel
席.hook: SEAT: a towel hangs at the bottom — the Secretary tags it as your seat.
席.picture: A secretary slapping name tags on damp towels spread on a cave floor as seats.

渡.label: water
渡.hook: TRANSIT: three splashes of water on the left — a Water balloon bursts mid-crossing.
渡.picture: A person wading across a river at an angle as a water balloon bursts on their head.

tips.発: discharge: teepee over two lines and open human legs
tips.登: ascend: teepee over beans (豆), a closed box on a stand

scene: From one teepee a cannon on two legs makes a discharge of confetti, and from another a climber with a bowl of beans begins to ascend.
contrast: Discharge rides on human legs · ascend lifts on a bean bowl

発.feature: human legs (two sweeping strokes) at the bottom
発.label: legs
発.hook: DISCHARGE: the cannons stand on two sweeping legs — BOOM, Mad Hatter's hat flies.
発.picture: Two cannons on long sweeping legs firing under a teepee, a top hat blasting into the sky.

登.feature: a bean bowl on a stand at the bottom (box, two dots, base line)
登.label: bean bowl
登.hook: ASCEND: a bean bowl on a stand sprouts and lifts the teepee — Toad rides the pole.
登.picture: A footed bowl of magic beans sprouting huge stalks lifting a teepee into the sky, a toad riding the tent pole.

tips.際: occasion: ritual (祭) with a pinnacle (阝) on the left
tips.察: guess: ritual under a house roof (宀)

scene: A festive ritual on a pinnacle marks a special occasion, while inside a roofed house a child tries to guess which ritual gift is hidden.
contrast: Occasion climbs a pinnacle on the left · guess hides the ritual under a house roof

際.feature: a pinnacle (ear-shaped hill, 阝) on the left
際.label: pinnacle
際.hook: OCCASION: villagers climb the hill on the left — Cyclops stares at the bonfire.

tips.易: easy: a sun directly over the pennant (勿), no line between

tips.陽: sunshine: pinnacle (阝) on the left; a line between the sun and the pennant

陽.feature: Pinnacle (阝) on the left: a cliff with two bumps.

陽.hook: SUNSHINE: Yoda climbs the bumpy pinnacle on the left to sunbathe his piggy bank.
陽.picture: A small green sage sitting on a tall bumpy rock spire on the left, holding up a golden piggy bank that glows in brilliant sunshine.

tips.良: good: a drop over a root, standing alone
tips.食: eat: an umbrella roof over good

contrast: Good stands bare under its honey drop · eat puts an umbrella roof over good

良.picture: A lion licking a golden honey drop that falls from open sky onto a blooming root, nothing overhead.

tips.飯: meal: eat + anti- (反), a cliff over a crotch

飲.picture: A person with an enormous wide-open yawning mouth while a young intern pours a pot of soup straight into it.

飯.feature: Anti (反) on the right: a flat cliff roof on top with a crossing below.

飯.picture: A messy diner at the edge of a flat-topped cliff, rice grains flying off the cliff edge, a space pilot aiming a blaster at chopsticks.

tips.半: half: two horns at the very top, no lid; the stem pokes up between them

contrast: Even has a flat lid on top · half has the stem poking up between the horns

平.feature: A flat lid line across the very top; the stem starts under it.

平.hook: EVEN: Hades irons a flat lid across the top — the stem can't poke through.
平.picture: A fiery underworld god ironing a perfectly flat plank lid on top of a pole, scorched horns squashed underneath.

半.feature: The vertical stem pokes up above the horns; no lid on top.

半.hook: HALF: Han Solo's laser shoots up through the top, splitting the horns in half.
半.picture: A red laser beam shooting straight up through the middle of a block, slicing it into two halves, horns flying apart on either side.

tips.帰: homecoming: two short strokes (saber) on the left + broom
tips.婦: lady: woman (女) on the left + broom

帰.picture: A small round kiwi bird hanging two tiny curved swords on a wall, then picking up a broom in a dusty home.

婦.label: woman
婦.hook: LADY: the prim woman on the left swings her broom and sweeps the footballer off her porch.
婦.picture: A prim lady in an apron swinging a broom that launches a muddy football player off her porch like a kicked ball.

tips.局: bureau: the flag's tail bends into a hook holding a small mouth
tips.居: reside: old (古: ten over a mouth) under the flag
tips.屋: roof: climax (至) stacked like ceilings under the flag

局.picture: A drooping flag whose tail curls like a hook holding a small rubber stamp over a stack of forms, a karate master chopping the pile.

居.feature: Old (古): a cross (十) over a mouth under the flag.

居.picture: A very old man in an armchair under a tattered flag, cobwebs everywhere, an eel coiled in his lap.

屋.feature: Climax (至): stacked layers ending in a long floor under the flag.
屋.label: climax (至)

屋.picture: A tall stacked rooftop party under a flag, a musician playing an ocarina so loud the roof flies off into the night sky.

tips.室: room: climax (至) under a house roof (宀)
tips.屋: roof: climax under a flag (尸) instead of a house roof

屋.feature: Flag (尸) on top with its long sweep down the left — no dot.
屋.label: flag
屋.hook: ROOF: the flag juts over the party until the ocarina blasts the roof away.
屋.picture: A flag hanging over a rooftop party, a musician blowing an ocarina so hard the roof flies off.

tips.突: stab: a dog (大) under the hole

突.feature: A big dog (大) spreading its arms under the hole.

tips.追: chase: mound (𠂤: a drop and two stacked bumps) on the road

tips.権: authority: tree (木) on the left of the horned turkey

tips.福: blessing: an altar (礻) on the left, no roof

tips.服: clothing: flesh (月) on the left of the stamp and crotch
tips.報: report: happiness (幸) on the left of the stamp and crotch

tips.料: fee: rice (米) beside the Big Dipper

tips.親: parent: vase over tree + see (見) on the right

tips.園: park: long robe (袁) enclosed in a box (囗)
tips.遠: distant: long robe riding on the road (辶), no box

tips.偉: admirable: person (亻) beside the locket (韋)
tips.違: difference: locket riding on the road (辶)

tips.文: sentence: a top hat (dot and line) over crossed sticks
tips.交: mingle: a top hat over father: dot, line, two dots and crossed sticks

tips.地: ground: soil (土) beside the scorpion (也)
