積.hook: The Secretary stacks wheat on the left to the ceiling; the VOLUME topples onto the office.
積.picture: A towering stack of drooping wheat sheaves leaning over and toppling into an office, papers flying.

tips.日: day: a squat closed box with one line inside, nothing on top
tips.月: month: two inner lines, the left side sweeps out down-left and the bottom stays open
tips.目: eye: a tall closed box with two lines inside, nothing on top
tips.自: oneself: eye (目) with a small drop on top
tips.耳: ear: the top line overhangs, the right stem runs past the bottom, the base slants up
tips.白: white: day (日) with a small drop on top

scene: A sun trapped in a square window with one bar, a crescent moon with an open bottom swishing its left leg, a tall upright eye with two lids, a single drop hanging over a second tall eye like a nose, a giant ear shaped like a ladder with rungs poking out, and a drop of bleach falling onto a small square sun that glows blank white.
contrast: day: a squat box with one bar · month: open bottom, left leg sweeps away · eye: a tall box with two bars · oneself: a drop on the tall eye · ear: rungs stick out like a ladder · white: a drop on the squat sun

日.feature: A squat closed box with just ONE line inside and nothing on top.
日.label: one bar
日.hook: Nietzsche locks the sun behind ONE window bar, nothing dripping on top, to end the DAY.
日.picture: A glowing sun trapped in a squat square window frame with a single bar across its middle, a philosopher with a big moustache locking it, clear sky above.

月.feature: The left side sweeps out down-left and the bottom stays open.
月.label: sweep left
月.hook: The getaway driver's moon has an open bottom; its left leg swishes away each MONTH.
月.picture: A tall crescent moon with an open bottom and a left leg sweeping out like a skirt, a getaway car racing off with it.

目.feature: A tall closed box with TWO lines inside.
目.label: two bars
目.hook: A giant EYE stands tall with two lids; the Mockingbird pecks, it just blinks 'Meh'.
目.picture: A tall upright eye with two horizontal eyelids inside, a mockingbird pecking at it, the eye bored.

自.feature: a drop on top of the eye (the nose)
自.label: nose drop
自.hook: ONESELF: a drop on top is your nose — the Jeep jabs it honking 'Me!'
自.picture: A muddy jeep pointing its antenna at a single drop above its headlight, honking.

耳.feature: the frame is open: top bar overhangs and the bottom rung kicks out to the left
耳.label: sticks out
耳.hook: EAR: a ladder whose rungs stick out past the frame — you shout and they rattle.
耳.picture: A giant ear shaped like a ladder with rungs sticking out past the sides, rattling as someone shouts.

白.feature: A drop (丿) on top of a squat sun box with just ONE line inside (not the tall eye).
白.label: drop
白.hook: The Hacker drips one drop of bleach onto the squat sun and the whole sky turns WHITE.
白.picture: A hacker in a hoodie leaning out of a window, dripping a single drop of bleach from a bottle onto a small square sun, the sky around it fading to blank white.

tips.大: large: a figure with arms outstretched, no dot and no top bar
tips.太: plump: a dot BELOW, between the legs
tips.犬: dog: a dot at the TOP right, like a perked ear
tips.天: heavens: an extra bar (一) across the top, no dot

scene: A large man spreads his arms wide, a plump man balances a ball between his feet, a dog with one perked ear at its upper right sits beside them, and a fourth figure bonks its head on a ceiling beam above.
contrast: large: a bare star-jump figure · plump: a dot drips between the legs · dog: a dot perks up at the top right · heavens: a ceiling bar over the head

大.feature: No dot and no extra bar: just a bare figure spreading arms and legs.
大.label: bare
大.hook: The Dinosaur flings arms and legs wide, nothing on top and nothing dripping, just LARGE.
大.picture: A muddy dinosaur doing a star jump under an open sky, arms and legs spread wide, a tiger fainting in front of it.

太.feature: A dot BELOW, between the legs.
太.label: dot below
太.hook: Stuffed PLUMP with doughnuts, the dog drips one blob of grease between its legs.
太.picture: A hugely fat St. Bernard dog with a single big drop of grease falling between its hind legs, doughnuts everywhere.

犬.feature: A dot at the TOP right, like a perked ear.
犬.label: dot = ear
犬.hook: The DOG's perked top-right ear flings one drop of drool onto Ken doll's hair.
犬.picture: A St. Bernard with one ear perked up at the top right, a drop of drool flying from it onto a doll's perfect hair.

天.feature: An extra bar (一) across the top, above the outstretched arms.
天.label: top bar
天.hook: The Tennis player smashes the dog skyward until its head bonks the ceiling bar of the HEAVENS.
天.picture: A tennis player swinging a racket, a St. Bernard flying upward with arms spread and bonking its head on a single long beam across the sky.

tips.左: left: craft (工) under the crossed hand
tips.右: right: mouth (口) under the crossed hand; the slash pokes above the line
tips.石: stone: mouth under a cliff; the slash starts at the line and does not poke above
tips.有: possess: a moon (月) under the crossed hand

scene: A carpenter holds an I-beam in his left hand and a cup in his right, standing beneath a flat cliff with a round stone under it, while a giant hand reaches down to grab a fallen moon.
contrast: left: the hand holds a craft I-beam · right: the hand feeds a mouth · stone: a flat cliff over a mouth, nothing poking · possess: the hand grabs a moon

左.feature: Craft (工, an I-beam) under the crossed hand.
左.label: craft
左.hook: The Samurai's LEFT hand fumbles over an I-beam craft project.
左.picture: A samurai clumsily drawing with his left hand, his right glued to a steel I-beam bench below.

右.feature: A mouth (口) under the crossed hand, the slash poking above the line.
右.label: mouth
右.hook: The RIGHT hand swoops the dumpling into your mouth below.
右.picture: A unicorn spearing a dumpling with its horn as a right hand pops it into an open mouth below.

石.feature: A flat cliff roof: the slash starts under the line and nothing pokes above.
石.label: cliff
石.hook: Under a flat cliff overhang the mouth's scream petrifies into STONE.
石.picture: A screaming mouth turned to stone beneath a flat rocky overhang, a secretary chiseling it off.

有.feature: A moon (月: open-bottomed frame with two bars) under the crossed hand.
有.label: moon
有.hook: The crossed hand slams onto the moon below: 'I POSSESS you!', and the Unicorn stabs it with her horn.
有.picture: A giant hand pinning a fallen crescent moon to the ground, a unicorn jabbing the hand with its horn.

tips.役: duty: going (彳) on the left of the missile (殳)
tips.投: throw: fingers (扌) on the left of the missile (殳: small table over a crotch)
tips.抜: slip out: fingers + 犮: a crossbar, slashes and a dot, no small table on top
tips.段: grade: stairs (a stem with little steps) on the left of the missile (殳)

scene: Two soldiers march a missile onto a yak, a hand hurls a hooded missile at a toad, a greased friend squirts out of another hand, and a dandy in a top hat climbs a staircase blasted into a cliff by a missile.
contrast: duty: two marching soldiers by the missile · throw: fingers grab the missile · slip out: fingers lose a slippery friend · grade: stairs climb beside the missile

役.feature: the 'going' radical (two stacked slants and a stem) on the left
役.label: going
役.hook: DUTY: two marching soldiers stacked on the left — they load the missile onto the Yak.
役.picture: Two soldiers marching in step, strapping a missile onto a groaning yak's back.

投.feature: a missile with a little hood on the right (next to fingers)
投.label: missile
投.hook: THROW: fingers hurl the hooded missile — Toad snags it mid-air with his tongue.
投.picture: A hand throwing a small hooded missile through the air, a toad catching it with its tongue.

抜.feature: a crossbar with one long slash sweeping through it on the right (friend)
抜.label: slash
抜.hook: SLIP OUT: the greased friend shoots out diagonally through the bar — the Bat cackles.
抜.picture: A greasy friend squirting diagonally out of a grabbing hand, a muddy bat cackling nearby.

段.feature: Stairs on the left: a slanted stem with little step bars jutting out to the right.
段.label: stairs
段.hook: The Dandy blasts stairs into the cliff and climbs them one GRADE at a time, tipping his hat.
段.picture: A mud-splattered gentleman in a top hat climbing a narrow staircase blasted into a cliff, a smoking missile on the right.

tips.動: move: heavy (重, slash on top) + power (力)
tips.勤: diligence: Sino- clay (堇, horns on top, no slash) + power
tips.働: work: move with a person (亻) on the left
tips.重: heavy: the bare core, no power (力) and no person

scene: A heavy boulder sits alone crushing a desk, a glowing fist shoves a second boulder along, a king with a two-pronged crown hauls clay, and a sweating worker pushes a third crate from the left.
contrast: move: power shoves the heavy boulder · diligence: crowned horns on the clay · work: a person pushes from the left · heavy: the boulder alone, no one to push

動.feature: Power (力) on the right of heavy, and no person on the left.
動.label: power
動.hook: Raw power slams the heavy boulder from the right and it starts to MOVE; Dodo waddles out.
動.picture: A glowing fist punching a heavy boulder from the right, the boulder sliding, a flattened dodo waddling out from under it.

勤.feature: two little horns (grass) poking up on the left top
勤.label: horns
勤.hook: DILIGENCE: two crown points poke up on the clay — King sweats under them all day.
勤.picture: A king with a two-pronged crown hauling clay bricks, sweat dripping.

働.feature: a person radical on the far left
働.label: person
働.hook: WORK: a person stands at the left pushing the heavy load — Dodo pecks his ankles.
働.picture: A sweating worker pushing a heavy crate, a muddy dodo pecking at his ankles.

重.feature: Heavy stands bare: no power (力) on the right, no person on the left.
重.label: bare
重.hook: With no help on either side, the Jewel thief tries to lift the bare HEAVY pile alone and his back snaps.
重.picture: A jewel thief straining alone to lift a pile of bricks stacked on a computer, his back bending, nobody nearby to help.

tips.使: use: person + officer (吏): line, a plain mouth box, crossed legs
tips.便: convenience: person + grow late (更): line, a box with a line inside, crossed legs
tips.更: grow late: the same as convenience but no person (亻) on the left

scene: An officer pokes his spear up through a beam, a person stands beside a glowing late-night shop window divided by one shelf, and a lone clock box with crossed sticks jammed through it hangs under a ceiling beam.
contrast: use: a spear pokes up over a plain mouth · convenience: a person by a box with a shelf line · grow late: the box and crossed sticks with no person

使.feature: The long slash-stem pokes up above the top line; under it a plain empty mouth box.
使.label: pokes up
使.hook: USE: the officer's spear pokes up through the top bar — he points it and uses two cows as tanks.
使.picture: An officer whose spear juts up through a wooden beam, pointing two cows forward like tanks.

便.feature: A person (亻) on the left of grow late: a box with a line inside, nothing poking above.
便.label: person
便.hook: A person stands beside the late-night shop window for your CONVENIENCE, selling a Bento box at 3 a.m.
便.picture: A shopkeeper standing beside a glowing late-night shop window with one shelf across it, holding out a bento box.

更.feature: No person on the left: just the top line over a box with a line inside and crossed sticks below.
更.label: no person
更.hook: Coach stands alone jamming crossed sticks through the clock box, and the night GROWS LATE forever.
更.picture: A coach with a megaphone jamming two crossed sticks through a boxy clock under a ceiling beam, a dark night sky outside, no one else around.

tips.争: contend: a small hook (⺈) on top, a broom, a stem hooking down through it
tips.急: hurry: the same top over a broom, but a heart (心) at the bottom
tips.事: matter: a line and a mouth (一 + 口) on top, the stem running down through everything

scene: A soldier wriggles out of a small hook and thrusts a spear down through a broom, a broom with a pounding heart under it rushes for a train, and a jeep rams a barbed broom down through a gossip's mouth under a beam.
contrast: contend: a hooked top and a spear through the broom · hurry: a heart beats under the broom · matter: a mouth on top, speared with the broom

争.feature: A small hooked top (⺈) over the broom, with the hooked spear running down through it.
争.label: hook top
争.hook: The Soldier wriggles out of the little hook on top and jams a spear down through the broom, ready to CONTEND.
争.picture: A soldier wriggling out of a small curled hook, thrusting a hooked spear down through a broom in a fighting stance.

急.feature: A heart (心) at the bottom instead of a stem.
急.label: heart
急.hook: HURRY: a pounding heart under the broom — run, the train doors are closing!
急.picture: A giant red pounding heart running toward closing train doors, a cucumber riding a broom on top of it.

事.feature: A line and a mouth box (一 over 口) on top, with the hooked spear running down through them and the broom.
事.label: mouth
事.hook: The Jeep rams the barbed broom down through the gossip's mouth on top: that's what poking into every MATTER gets you.
事.picture: A muddy jeep ramming a broom with a barbed tip down through a gossip's open mouth, pinned under a wooden beam.

tips.学: study: schoolhouse (three sparks over a lid) over a child (子)
tips.字: character: a house roof (宀: a dot on a hooked lid) over a child (子)

scene: A child studies under a school roof with three sparks crackling on top, an eyeball on legs stares at a blackboard under a second sparking roof, and another child scratches glowing letters under a small house roof with a single chimney dot.
contrast: study: a child under the sparking schoolhouse · memorize: an eye on legs under the schoolhouse · character: a child under a plain house roof with one dot

学.feature: The schoolhouse roof: three little sparks (⺍) over a flat lid (冖), with a child under it.
学.label: sparks
学.hook: Three sparks crackle on the schoolhouse roof while the child below is forced to STUDY, splattered by Guacamole.
学.picture: A small child at a desk under a school roof with three sparks crackling on top, a green guacamole monster splattering dip on him.

覚.feature: Under the schoolhouse roof: see 見, a tall eye on legs.
覚.label: eye on legs
覚.hook: MEMORIZE: a huge eye on legs stares at the board once — the Cactus prickles it awake.
覚.picture: An enormous eyeball on legs staring at a blackboard, a cactus poking it, an oboe tooting.

字.feature: A house roof (宀: one dot on a lid with hooked ends) over the child, no sparks.
字.label: house
字.hook: Under a plain house roof with one chimney dot, the child scratches CHARACTERs on the walls; the Jeep crashes in to read them.
字.picture: A child scratching glowing symbols onto the walls under a tiny house roof with a single chimney, a muddy jeep bursting through the door with headlights on.

tips.列: file: bones (歹) + saber (刂), nothing on the left
tips.例: example: file with a person (亻) added on the left

scene: A skeleton army marches in a single line past a standing saber, and one soldier steps out in front, a raven on his helmet, held up as the model.
contrast: file: bones line up by a saber · example: a person joins on the left

列.feature: Nothing on the left: just bones (歹) and a saber (刂).
列.label: no person
列.hook: The saber herds the bones into a single FILE, nobody beside them; the Lettuce trembles at the end of the line.
列.picture: A skeleton army queueing in a perfect single line beside a tall saber, a trembling lettuce last in the queue.

例.feature: A person (亻) standing on the left of file.
例.label: person
例.hook: One person steps up beside the file and marches so well he becomes the EXAMPLE; a Raven copies his steps.
例.picture: A soldier marching in front of a line of skeletons, a drill sergeant pointing at him, a raven perched on his helmet.

tips.真: true: a cross (十) on top, eye (目), then a plank and two legs (一 + 八)
tips.直: straightaway: a cross (十) on top, eye (目), an L-hook wrapping under it, no legs
tips.具: tool: no cross on top: eye (目) on a plank with two legs (一 + 八)

scene: A giant eye under a cross stands on a plank with two spindly legs, a second eye under crosshairs rests in a big L-shaped fishhook, and a third bare eye on a cutting board with two whisk legs scuttles away.
contrast: true: a cross over an eye on spindly legs · straightaway: a cross over an eye in a fishhook · tool: an eye on legs, no cross

真.feature: Both: a cross (十) on top AND a plank with two legs (一 + 八) below the eye.
真.label: cross + legs
真.hook: The Shinto priest confesses before the eye under the cross on its spindly legs; only what's TRUE shows.
真.picture: A Shinto priest kneeling before a giant eye topped by a cross, standing on a plank with two thin legs, the eye glowing.

直.feature: A cross (十) on top and an L-shaped hook wrapping the eye's left side and bottom; no legs.
直.label: fishhook
直.hook: Through crosshairs the eye stares STRAIGHTAWAY at you from its fishhook cradle, and the Chocolate bar melts.
直.picture: A giant eye with crosshairs above it, cradled in a huge L-shaped fishhook, a chocolate bar melting under its stare.

具.feature: No cross on top: the eye sits bare on a plank with two legs (一 + 八).
具.label: no cross
具.hook: The Gourmet's TOOL monster wears no cross: just an eye on a cutting board with whisk legs.
具.picture: A kitchen monster made of a giant eye on a cutting board with two whisk legs scuttling off with dinner, a muddy gourmet chasing it.

tips.始: commence: woman (女) on the left of the pedestal (台)
tips.治: reign: water (氵) on the left of the pedestal (台)
tips.台: pedestal: elbow (ム) over mouth (口), nothing on the left

scene: A woman leaps onto a pedestal firing a starting pistol, a queen on a second pedestal rules over water splashing in from the side, and a third bare pedestal made of a giant elbow on a screaming mouth stands empty.
contrast: commence: a woman leaps on the pedestal · reign: water floods by the pedestal · pedestal: the elbow and mouth alone

始.feature: A woman (女) on the left of the pedestal.
始.label: woman
始.hook: A woman leaps onto the pedestal and fires the pistol to COMMENCE the race; Sheep bolt from the line.
始.picture: A woman jumping onto a pedestal firing a starting pistol, a flock of sheep bolting off a starting line.

治.feature: Water (氵: three drops) on the left of the pedestal.
治.label: water
治.hook: The queen REIGNS from her pedestal over the water flooding in; the Jeep ferries her ministers through.
治.picture: A queen on a pedestal with water flooding in from the left, a muddy jeep splashing through carrying ministers.

台.feature: Nothing on the left: just an elbow (ム) over a mouth (口).
台.label: alone
台.hook: The bare elbow on the mouth makes a PEDESTAL; the Dinosaur climbs on it to reach the shelf.
台.picture: A giant elbow resting on a screaming mouth like a stand, a dinosaur standing on top reaching for a kitchen shelf.

tips.未: not yet: tree (木) with a short line over a longer one, nothing on the left
tips.味: flavor: mouth (口) on the left of not yet (未)
tips.妹: younger sister: woman (女) on the left of not yet (未)

scene: A small tree marked with a short line near its top, an open mouth biting a sour green fruit, and a little girl pouting beside a second small tree.
contrast: not yet: the bare tree with a short top line · flavor: a mouth bites the unripe fruit · younger sister: a little woman beside it

未.feature: Nothing on the left: just a tree (木) with a short line above the longer one.
未.label: alone
未.hook: Mickey Mouse marks a short line on the bare tree each morning and sighs: NOT YET.
未.picture: Mickey Mouse measuring a small tree against a short line marked high on its trunk, sighing.

味.feature: A mouth (口) on the left of not yet.
味.label: mouth
味.hook: Mickey Mouse stuffs unripe fruit into your mouth: a FLAVOR so sour your face caves in.
味.picture: Mickey Mouse stuffing a hard green fruit into a wide open mouth, the face puckering from sourness.

妹.feature: A woman (女) on the left of not yet.
妹.label: woman
妹.hook: The not-yet-grown little woman is your YOUNGER SISTER; the Mime copies her every pout.
妹.picture: A small pouting girl next to a mime silently copying her pout, her eyes welling with tears.

tips.式: style: arrow (弋) over craft (工), nothing on the left
tips.試: test: style with words (言: say) on the left

scene: An arrow quivers upright on a small I-beam workbench, and next to an identical bench a row of sheep bleat answers at a panel of judges.
contrast: style: an arrow stuck in a craft bench · test: words spoken beside it

式.feature: Nothing on the left: just the arrow (弋) frame with craft (工) under it.
式.label: alone
式.hook: The Sheikh's arrow lands quivering on the bare craft bench: pure STYLE.
式.picture: A sheikh on a camel bowing as his arrow quivers upright on a small I-beam workbench.

試.feature: Words (言: say) on the left of style.
試.label: say
試.hook: Sheep say every answer aloud beside the bench to TEST the judges; wrong ones get sheared.
試.picture: A row of sheep bleating answers at a panel of judges, one sheep being sheared bald on stage.

tips.貧: poverty: part (分: two flared strokes over a sword 刀) over shells (貝)
tips.貸: lend: substitute (代: a person and an arrow) over shells (貝)
tips.資: assets: next (次: two drops and a yawning mouth) over shells (貝)

scene: A sword slices a beggar's last shells apart, a substitute teacher holding an arrow perches on another pile of shells, and a yawning sheep banker sits on a huge heap of shells.
contrast: poverty: a sword parts the shells · lend: a person with an arrow begs for shells · assets: two drops and a yawn pile onto the shells

貧.feature: Part (分: two slashes flaring out over a sword 刀) on top of the shells.
貧.label: part
貧.hook: The tax collector's sword parts the beggar from his shells: POVERTY, and a muddy Bin for a home.
貧.picture: A sword slicing a small pile of shells away from a beggar, who sits in a muddy trash bin.

貸.feature: Substitute (代: a person beside an arrow) on top of the shells.
貸.label: substitute
貸.hook: A substitute teacher perched on my shells begs me to LEND him some; the Tiger pounces to collect.
貸.picture: A substitute teacher with an arrow-shaped pointer perched on a pile of shells, a tiger leaping at him.

資.feature: Next (次: two little drops beside a yawning mouth 欠) on top of the shells.
資.label: next
資.hook: The Sheep banker on top yawns 'Next!' as customers pour their ASSETS into the shells below.
資.picture: A yawning sheep in a banker's tie sitting atop a heap of shells, customers pouring more shells around her.

tips.書: write: a brush (聿: stacked bars pierced by a stem) over a sun (日)
tips.昼: daytime: a flute (尺: a flag shape with a sweeping leg) over sunrise (旦: sun over a line)

scene: A giant brush with stacked bristle bands dips into a sun below it, and next to it a long flute blasts over a sun rising off the horizon line.
contrast: write: a brush of stacked bars dips into the sun · daytime: a flute sweeps over the sun rising from the ground line

書.feature: A brush (聿: many stacked bars with a stem through them) sitting right on the sun (日), no ground line.
書.label: brush
書.hook: The Shopkeeper dips his giant brush into the sun and WRITEs prices in fire across his window.
書.picture: A cackling shopkeeper dipping a giant brush into a glowing sun and writing flames across a shop window.

昼.feature: A flute (尺: a flag shape with a sweeping leg) over a sun standing on a ground line (旦).
昼.label: flute
昼.hook: Chewbacca blasts his flute so loud the sun leaps off the horizon into full DAYTIME.
昼.picture: Chewbacca blowing a long bamboo flute, a sun leaping up off a flat horizon line into a bright sky.

tips.画: brush stroke: one line over a rice field (田) in an open-top bucket (凵)
tips.面: mask: a bar with a slash (丆) over a closed box with a long nose ridge inside

scene: A rice field painted inside an open-topped bucket under one painted line, beside a boxy mask with a brow bar, a long nose ridge and square eyeholes.
contrast: brush stroke: a rice field sits in an open bucket · mask: a closed box with a nose ridge

画.feature: An open-topped bucket (凵) holding a rice field (田), under one line.
画.label: bucket
画.hook: The Cactus drags one line over a rice field in an open bucket on the Garage door: each BRUSH STROKE screeches.
画.picture: A cactus with paint-dipped spines painting a rice field inside an open bucket on a garage door, one line across the top.

面.feature: A closed box all round, a bar with a short slash on top (丆) and a long nose ridge inside.
面.label: closed box
面.hook: Your Mentor slams a closed boxy MASK onto your face, its nose ridge running down the middle.
面.picture: An old mentor pressing a boxy mask with a brow bar, long nose ridge and square eyeholes onto a student's face.

tips.皆: all: compare (比: two figures facing the same way) over white (白)
tips.背: stature: north (北: two figures back to back) over flesh (月)

scene: Two people side by side facing the same way flash white teeth over a crowd, while two kids stand back to back against a wall to measure their height.
contrast: all: two smiles face the same way over white teeth · stature: two kids back to back over flesh

皆.feature: Compare (比: two figures facing the same way) over white (白: a drop on a sun).
皆.label: same way
皆.hook: Two people facing the same way compare smiles, then ALL the crowd flashes white teeth at once.
皆.picture: Two people side by side facing the same direction grinning, a whole crowd below flashing blinding white teeth.

背.feature: North (北: two figures back to back) over flesh (月).
背.label: back to back
背.hook: The Hyena shoves two kids back to back and cackles at whoever loses in STATURE.
背.picture: A cackling hyena pushing two kids back to back against a wall, measuring their heights.

tips.思: think: a rice field (田) over a heart (心)
tips.男: male/man: a rice field (田) over power (力)

scene: Sheep graze a rice field on top of a man's head while his heart thuds below, and a dandy drags a whole rice field with a flexed arm.
contrast: think: a field over a heart · male/man: a field over power

思.feature: A heart (心: three dots and a curve) under the rice field.
思.label: heart
思.hook: Sheep hooves thud from the field down into your heart: you can't THINK of anything but sheep.
思.picture: Sheep grazing a tiny rice field on top of a person's head, a red heart thudding in his chest.

男.feature: Power (力: a hooked arm) under the rice field.
男.label: power
男.hook: The Dandy drags the rice field with raw power to prove he's a real MAN.
男.picture: A muddy gentleman in a top hat and monocle dragging a whole rice field with a flexed arm.

tips.知: know: a dart (矢: a short slash over two bars with spread legs) by a mouth (口)
tips.和: harmony: wheat (禾: a drooping ear over a tree) by a mouth (口)

scene: A chimpanzee throws a dart into a liar's mouth, while next to it a drooping wheat stalk feeds a happy mouth as a walrus conducts a song.
contrast: know: a dart flies into the mouth · harmony: wheat feeds the mouth

知.feature: A dart (矢) on the left: a short slash over two bars, legs spread wide.
知.label: dart
知.hook: The Chimpanzee throws a dart into the liar's mouth and now you KNOW everything.
知.picture: A shrieking chimpanzee throwing a dart into a liar's open mouth, the truth spilling out.

和.feature: Wheat (禾) on the left: a drooping ear over a tree with a stem down the middle.
和.label: wheat
和.hook: Ripe wheat feeds the hungry mouth and the village sighs in HARMONY; the Walrus conducts.
和.picture: A drooping wheat stalk feeding a smiling mouth, a walrus conducting a village choir.

tips.指: finger: fingers (扌) + delicious (旨: a spoon 匕 over a sun 日)
tips.招: beckon: fingers (扌) + seduce (召: a sword 刀 over a mouth 口)

scene: A hand licks a spoon dripping over a glowing dish, and another hand with a glittering manicure curls a beckoning finger above a sword and an open mouth.
contrast: finger: a spoon over a sun · beckon: a sword over a mouth

指.feature: Delicious (旨): a spoon (匕) over a sun box with a line inside (日).
指.label: spoon
指.hook: Your fingers dip a spoon into the delicious dish and you suck each FINGER loudly.
指.picture: A person sucking their fingers next to a spoon dipped in a glowing dish, a restaurant crowd staring.

招.feature: Seduce (召): a sword (刀) over an empty mouth box (口).
招.label: sword
招.hook: The Showman's manicured fingers curl over a sword and a mouth, BECKONING you into his tent.
招.picture: A showman with glittering nails curling a finger to beckon, a small sword over an open mouth at his tent entrance.

tips.待: wait: going (彳) + temple (寺: soil 土 over glue 寸)
tips.得: gain: going (彳) + sunrise (旦: sun over a line) over glue (寸)

scene: A traveller waits at a temple gate on a mound of soil beside a licking tiger, while another traveller walks off at sunrise with coins glued to his boots.
contrast: wait: soil over glue makes a temple · gain: a sun on a line over glue

待.feature: Soil (土: a cross on a long base) over glue (寸): a temple.
待.label: soil
待.hook: You WAIT at the temple gate on its mound of soil while the Tiger leans closer.
待.picture: A person waiting at a temple gate on a small mound of earth, a tiger beside them licking its lips.

得.feature: A sun on a line (旦: sunrise) over glue (寸).
得.label: sunrise
得.hook: Setting off at sunrise with coins glued to your boots, you GAIN a fortune; the Talk-show host begs for the story.
得.picture: A traveller walking at sunrise with gold coins glued to his boots, a talk-show host chasing him with a microphone.

tips.余: too much: an umbrella (人 roof) over a tree with spread feet, nothing beside it
tips.除: exclude: too much with a pinnacle (阝) on the left
tips.途: route: too much riding a road (辶) underneath

scene: A tiny umbrella overflowing with yogurt sits over a tree, a jockey is thrown off a rocky pinnacle beside a second umbrella tree, and a toddler waddles along a road curving under a third.
contrast: too much: the umbrella tree alone · exclude: a pinnacle on the left · route: a road curves underneath

余.feature: Nothing beside it: just an umbrella (人 roof) over a tree with spread feet.
余.label: alone
余.hook: Yogurt pours onto the lone umbrella over the tree: TOO MUCH, it overflows.
余.picture: A tiny umbrella over a small tree, yogurt pouring from the sky and overflowing it.

除.feature: A pinnacle (阝: a hooked ear shape) on the left.
除.label: pinnacle
除.hook: Too much luggage on the pinnacle, so you EXCLUDE the extra: the muddy Jockey gets thrown off first.
除.picture: A muddy jockey being tossed off a rocky peak piled with luggage.

途.feature: A road (辶) curving underneath and around the bottom.
途.label: road
途.hook: The road underneath is jammed, so the Toddler waddles off on a secret ROUTE between the cars.
途.picture: A toddler waddling between jammed cars on a road that curves underneath, sitting down bawling halfway.
